text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. 47 Camden Inc. is constructing a 17-storey condominium building at 35-47 Camden Street. The site is located on the south side of Camden Street, approximately 40 metres east of Brant Street. Transportation Services is requesting authorization to temporarily close the south sidewalk and a 2.3 metre wide portion of the westbound curb lane on the south side of Camden Street for a period of 41 months, from July 6, 2026 to December 6, 2029, in order to facilitate construction staging operations for the development. Pedestrians on the south sidewalk will be redirected to a 2.1 metre wide covered and protected walkway located within the closed portion of the south curb lane.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Deferred consideration of the Item until the July 8 and 9, 2026 meeting of Toronto and East York Community Council.
